result.description: Work management platform for teams to organize tasks, projects, and workflows.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 authorization code grant (recommended for multi-user apps; 1h access tokens + refresh, PKCE for native/localhost); Personal Access Token (bearer); Service Account token (Enterprise only); OpenID Connect for login.
result.access_detail: Developer creates OAuth app or PAT in developer console (app.asana.com/0/my-apps). Review not required to obtain a token; App Directory review only for public listing. Free domains have API rate tier (150 req/min) vs paid 1,500/min. Free plan API access implied by rate-limit table, not stated outright.
result.api_notes: REST API is primary platform feature; also webhooks, batch API, app components, SCIM, audit log events. Endpoint count not directly verified but covers tasks, projects, portfolios, goals, custom fields, etc.

evidence.quote: Asana supports the authorization code grant flow
Asana uses OAuth 2.0 for secure user authorization.
A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
Submitting your app for review is not required to obtain a token.
Limits are based on minute-long windows and differ depending on whether the domain is free or paid
Asana apps use features like our rest API, app components, and webhooks.
The Asana MCP V2 server is available at: `https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp`.
This server requires authentication with your Asana account.
